messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
On 1 March 2027 a distributor is about to make a machine (not partly completed machinery) available on the market. Under the act applicable on that day, which items must it verify before doing so?

response.text: Which items must a distributor check before making a machine (not partly completed machinery) available on the market on 1 March 2027, according to the act that is in force on that day?
